feeds.title: Ready Set Jet Set
feeds.description: Welcome to Ready Set Jet Set. Haley is the blogger behind Ready Set Jet Set, a travel blog based out of Austin, Texas featuring all the best in solo female travel, adventure travel, weekend getaways, and so much more. She'll go wherever the wind takes her!

feeds.title: Eat Sleep Breathe Travel
feeds.description: Hannah Logan is an entrepreneur and solo female traveler from Canada. Through this blog, she shares tips, guides, business tips, and personal stories so that you can find adventure around the world.

feeds.title: Meganywhere
feeds.description: Welcome to Meganywhere, a solo female travel blog designed to inspire you to travel smarter, maximize your paid time off, and explore more!

feeds.title: Ready To Stare » Travel
feeds.description: This section features articles on travel. Alysse Dalessandro is a Midwest plus size fashion blogger, LGBTQ influencer, writer, designer, and professional speaker based in Cleveland, Ohio.

feeds.title: Taylor's Tracks
feeds.description: I'm Taylor, the creator of this blog that is dedicated to sharing the power and magic behind learning, growth, and connection. I love to share and teach my passions with the world and I believe that travel and yoga, the two main topics of this blog go hand-in-hand, as they're both transformational experiences that encourage you to be present and reflect on your life.

feeds.title: With Wonder and Whimsy » Travel
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Liz! With Wonder and Whimsy is my space to explore the personal style, plus size fashion, travel, and romancing the everyday. In the section dedicated to travel, I share ideas and tips on luggage and travel accessories, destination travel guides, and couples travel tips.

feeds.title: The Fat Girls Guide » Travel
feeds.description: The Fat Girls Guide is the official blog for the Fat Girls Traveling movement. This fat positive platform is dedicated to telling fat stories, highlighting fat bodies, and changing the landscape of travel, fashion and lifestyle brands.

feeds.title: Wannabe Princess » Travel
feeds.description: A Lifestyle Blog by Debz Louise. From opinionated rants about size acceptance to shopping for a bargain and from nights out to crazy online dating stories - you'll read about it all here!

feeds.title: Lovely In LA » Travel
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rachel Richardson, the founder of Lovely in LA. I help brands navigate the bridge between plus and standard style while inspiring and equipping my audience to look and feel their absolute best. Lovely in LA documents my ongoing adventures including travel, personal style and career in the fashion industry.

feeds.title: Stephanie Yeboah Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie has been an active presence within the influencer space; writing and creating content surrounding a variety of subjects including plus-size fashion, beauty, travel and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Wander Big
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Lynli Roman, solo traveler, digital nomad, and general mischief-maker. Let me show you how striking out on a new adventure- whether it's around the world alone or a local day trip with friends- can change your world one view at a time.

feeds.title: The Huntswoman » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Brianne! I'm a fashion designer, creative consultant and plus-size lifestyle blogger. I'm a Sagittarius, so of course I'm all about that travel! From weekend getaways in the USA, to cruises and month long escapes in Europe - we'll cover it all!

feeds.title: Franny the Traveler Blog
feeds.description: Read travel stories & tips through the lens of an unapologetic, black, plus-size traveler and educator who works hard and TRAVELS HARDER! My passion for travel led me to start my travel blog so I could share the stories of my adventures as I conquer at least two new countries and two new states.

feeds.title: Living Wonderfilled Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kristina, a 30-something First Generation American. I created Living Wonderfilled because that's what I do - live a life full of wonder and curiosity, driven by a desire to explore the unknown and learn all I can. Since I started LW, I've moved from Nashville to Madrid to Saint Petersburg, FL. I've explored my identity as a plus size blogger, my confidence as a woman, and currently a vegan lifestyle! LW goes where I go - and it's never where we thought we'd end up.

feeds.title: Plus Size in Seattle » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Aleesha, a Plus Size Fashion lover and Photographer from Seattle. I love talking about how we are fixing up our 1950's home, plus size fashion, travel and life with two small kids in Seattle.

feeds.title: Plus Size Travel Too Blog
feeds.description: We want to make sure plus size travellers feel confident and comfortable while they're travelling. From overcoming anxieties to facing the barriers to travel, it's our mission to ensure nobody feels as though their body is not meant for travel. We know that travel is not one size fits all industry and so to help, we have created the Plus Size Travel Too website as a hub of plus size experts, all looking to share their knowledge with fellow-travellers.
